JNI Batching Batches GL calls together instead of dispatching each one across the JNI boundary immediately (GL4ES-family renderers only). Cached JNI References Keeps vertex data in VBOs instead of re-uploading client-side arrays on every call (GL4ES-family renderers only). Native Object Pooling Reuses framebuffer objects instead of recreating them each time (GL4ES-family renderers only). Reduced JNI Calls Skips a redundant texture copy GL4ES otherwise performs on certain upload paths (GL4ES-family renderers only). Always clamped to 1-16, falling back to 8 if the device reports something bogus. Auto Detect Cores Detects this device\'s core count each launch via Runtime.availableProcessors(). Off only matters alongside Manual Override below. Manual Override Overrides Auto Detect Cores globally with the core count set below. Core Count Used when Manual Override (or a per-instance override) is active. Per-Instance Override Lets a specific instance\'s own CPU Core Override (set in that instance\'s Version Settings) take priority over the global pick above. Advanced CPU Tuning Reveals Thread Affinity and Scheduler Tuning below. Thread Affinity Pins the JVM\'s worker threads toward this device\'s big/performance cores instead of leaving core placement to the OS scheduler. Scheduler Tuning Hints the native side to favor steadier frame delivery over raw throughput under CPU contention. Memory Optimizer Auto RAM Calculator Keeps the allocated RAM pinned to the best pick for this device instead of a value you set by hand on the Game Settings slider. Equal Heap Sizes -Xms = -Xmx: reserves the full heap up front for fewer heap-resize GC pauses. Off starts the heap at half of -Xmx and lets the JVM grow it as needed. RAM Preset Quick presets for the RAM slider in Game Settings. Low Balanced High Custom Device RAM Memory Pressure Monitor Periodically checks the system\'s memory pressure and warns before the OS is likely to kill the game process outright. GC Statistics Logs every GC pause to gc.log in the launcher cache directory, for diagnosing a slow session after the fact. JNI Optimization GL4ES-family renderers only (Holy GL4ES). No effect on LTW, MobileGlues, Zink, VirGL, VGPU, or Freedreno. FPS Boost (Game Performance) Unlimited FPS Mode Removes Minecraft\'s 300-FPS cap and disables explicit GC pauses. May increase heat and battery drain. Low Latency Rendering Enables JVM string and compilation optimizations that reduce per-frame allocation overhead for smoother rendering. Frame Pacing Activates LWJGL frame pacing hints for more evenly spaced frame delivery on mobile GPUs. Frame Skipping Allows the renderer to drop frames when overloaded instead of queuing them. Reduces input lag on low-end devices. Adaptive Frame Timing Uses G1GC with short max-pause targets (10ms) to prevent garbage collection from stalling mid-frame. Auto Memory Cleanup Periodically runs a G1 garbage collection during idle stretches to release memory back to the system, instead of holding onto peak usage all session. Auto Graphics Auto Settings Optimizer Automatically tunes renderer, driver, RAM allocation, resolution scale, and FPS Boost flags for your device at launch. Recommended for most users. External Support Graphics Backend Quick switch between OpenGL and Vulkan rendering. This is a shortcut for the detailed Renderer option below — OpenGL picks GL4ES, Vulkan picks Zink. Prefer OpenGL On uses the OpenGL (GL4ES) renderer. Off switches to Vulkan (Zink). Same shortcut as the detailed Renderer option below — default is On (OpenGL).
